body: I tend to agree, that `runtime[DefaultInfo]` should have just worked, and re-creating it sounds like a workaround, rather than a proper fix.

I just hit this issue as well (detailed reproducer at https://gist.github.com/fmeum/97bd7198ece1f2c02bfbad11443331ce). It is a very good way to loose quite a bit of time because it's hard to come up with the idea that this *wouldn't* just work.

@brandjon Would you be able to raise the priority back to at least P3? If so, I would start to investigate the root cause and hope to create a PR.

issue.title: Retain runfiles when forwarding DelegatingDefaultInfo

repository.name: bazel
repository.description: a fast, scalable, multi-language and extensible build system

issue.body:
Before this change, returning a DefaultInfo obtained from a native rule target from a Starlark rule would lose the data_runfiles and
default_runfiles. This could only be worked around by creating a DefaultInfo provider instance in Starlark explicitly setting these
fields.

This is fixed by having the DelegatingDefaultInfo return null instead of an empty Runfiles object for the stateless runfiles, which indicates to addSimpleProviders in StarlarkRuleConfiguredTargetUtils that default and data runfiles should be used instead. Previously, this logic would only use the always empty stateless runfiles.

Fixes #9442.
